unit.why: A brief occasion (eating the host's leftovers while lodging) serves only to introduce an explanation of why a householder's shirayim bring awe and a tzaddik's bring livelihood; there is no real narrative event.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a numbered series on shirayim (item 7, cited from ס׳ ר"ד); the next division begins a separate item about R. Zusha.
